# Parse the old songs list from file content
import re
content = file_result['content']
old_songs = []
for line in content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: "- Song Title by Artist"
        # Remove leading "- "
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " (last occurrence)
        if ' by ' in song_str:
            title, artist = song_str.rsplit(' by ', 1)
            old_songs.append((title.strip(), artist.strip()))
print(old_songs)
